name: Bayesian Curl
summary: A cable biceps curl performed facing away from a low pulley with the shoulder extended to place the long head of the biceps in a stretched position.

setup: Set a cable pulley to the lowest position and attach a single D-handle.
Grasp the handle with a supinated grip and face directly away from the machine.
Take a step forward into a staggered stance until the cable is taut and your working arm is pulled behind your torso into shoulder extension.
steps: Keep your upper arm stationary behind your torso to maintain a stretch across the biceps.
Curl the handle forward and upward by flexing at the elbow until peak contraction is achieved.
Squeeze the biceps at the top for a brief moment.
Lower the weight with control, resisting the cable as your arm extends fully back into the stretched starting position.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the weight forward; inhale as you lower it with control into the stretch.
cues: Feel the deep stretch at the bottom
Curl your hand toward your shoulder without swinging

common_faults.fault: Drifting the elbow forward during the curl
common_faults.correction: Keep the upper arm anchored behind your torso to maintain shoulder extension and focus tension on the long head of the biceps.

common_faults.fault: Using torso momentum or leaning forward
common_faults.correction: Brace your core and maintain an upright, stable staggered stance throughout the repetition.

precautions: Avoid letting the cable aggressively jerk your arm back into hyperextension at the bottom of the movement.
